propositions: Remove orphaned, duplicates, and stale SYNC-dependent output cells from all fsck consumers including CLI, library, generated TypedDict, MCP model, JSON schema, and documentation

Implement unknown_event_types detection using git grep and git show against refs/heads/tickets without requiring a tickets checkout, with fail-closed RebarError(returncode=2) semantics for Git/ref operational failures

Add store_integrity offline binding audit with six specific finding kinds (forward_missing_jira_key, forward_missing_reverse, forward_reverse_mismatch, reverse_missing_forward, reverse_nonconfirmed_forward, reverse_jira_key_mismatch) requiring exit 1 on any mismatch between forward and reverse indexes

Gate exit semantics: unknown_event_types remains informational and does not change exit status, binding_drift remains informational, store_integrity findings and operational scan errors gate with exit 1 and exit 2 respectively

Maintain backward compatibility: rebar bridge-fsck remains callable with identical result and exit semantics as canonical rebar bridge fsck, and preserve live BRIDGE_ALERT infrastructure and bridge-status entrypoint

Remove SYNC-only scan machinery including _STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, _to_ns, --now-ts parameters and associated fixtures while retaining reconciler liveness detection via refs/reconciler/last-pass
